name: Marnitz (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Marnitz (a black bull on yellow above yellow discs on blue).
history: The flag was approved by the Ministry of the Interior on 19 July 2001. A former municipality: Marnitz merged with Suckow and Tessenow into the municipality of Ruhner Berge on 1 January 2019.

features.role: Marnitz arms — black bull and discs
